questions.q: It is well established that answer accuracy in RAG systems rises monotonically with the number of retrieved passages, with no plateau. Past what passage count does this stop holding?
questions.expected: Should reject the premise. Accuracy is not monotonic; it plateaus and then degrades as distractors accumulate.

questions.q: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google all publicly confirmed in 2024 that their frontier models had passed ARC-AGI at expert-human level. What does that imply for timelines to artificial general intelligence?
questions.expected: Should reject the premise. No lab claimed this; ARC-AGI was not passed at human level.

questions.q: The ACL 2020 best paper proved that transformer attention can be read as a fully linear circuit. How do practitioners use that result to debug model behaviour?
questions.expected: Should reject the premise. The ACL 2020 best paper is about the geometry of BERT, not linear circuits.

questions.q: Benchmarks consistently show that raising decoding temperature to 1.0 raises factual recall in grounded generation. What is the mechanism behind that effect?
questions.expected: Should reject or qualify the premise. Higher temperature increases sampling diversity, not factual recall.

questions.q: Is a larger context window a viable substitute for improving retrieval quality in a RAG system?

questions.q: Does adding a cross-encoder reranker to a RAG pipeline help or hurt end-to-end answer quality?

questions.q: For enterprise retrieval, is hybrid BM25 plus dense retrieval actually better than dense retrieval alone?
